entries.note: MMP (Akeron MP) launcher: the tube and its sight and firing unit on the left.

entries.author: US Army Photo by Sgt. Matthew Hulet, Viper Combat Camera USAREUR
entries.note: German paratrooper standing in a field, front-left quarter, full body: Flecktarn uniform, olive plate carrier with pouches, covered helmet with NVG mount, G36 held low, face paint.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Three Bundeswehr soldiers walking, front quarter, full body: Flecktarn uniforms, Flecktarn plate carriers with pouches, covered helmets, gloves, G36 rifles at the ready, dark boots.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Bundeswehr soldier aiming round a wall, near side profile, full body: Flecktarn trousers and sleeves, coyote plate carrier, helmet with cover and NVG mount, knee pads, rifle shouldered.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Two Bundeswehr soldiers running, front quarter, full body: Flecktarn uniforms and carriers, helmets with headsets, glasses, rifles at the ready.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Bundeswehr soldiers clearing a house, several seen from behind: Flecktarn uniforms, carrier backs, helmet rears; small figures.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Staff Sgt. Thomas Duval, Multinational Battle Group-East Public Affairs
entries.note: Bundeswehr soldier aiming a G36, close-up: Flecktarn helmet cover with NVG mount, face cover, carrier straps, the G36's carry-handle optic and slab sides.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Spc. Lloyd Villanueva
entries.note: German soldier aiming a G36 round a wall, close: the G36's side profile (carry-handle optic, skeleton folding stock, slim handguard, curved translucent magazine), Flecktarn jacket, helmet.

entries.author: Boevaya mashina
entries.note: G36A3 on a table, side: rail handguard, folding stock, optic rail, drum and box magazines; the current Bundeswehr rifle.

entries.author: U.S. Army Photo by Sgt. Jarred Woods, 16th Mobile Public Affairs Detachment
entries.note: German sniper prone, close: Flecktarn boonie hat and jacket, flag on the sleeve, sand-wrapped rifle on a bipod.

entries.author: U.S. Army Reserve photo by Michel Sauret
entries.note: French infantryman (92e RI, Saber Junction 23, Sept. 2023) standing beside a VBCI, front-left quarter, full body: CCE uniform, coyote plate carrier with chest pouches and name tape, helmet hidden under a scrim of burlap, HK416 F with optic held low, brown boots.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Christian Aquino
entries.note: French squad (92e RI, Saber Junction 23, Sept. 2023) walking in file, front quarter, full body: CCE uniforms, coyote plate carriers with pouches, helmets dressed in burlap scrim, HK416 F rifles, flag patches; sunny, small figures.

entries.author: U.S. Army Reserve photo by Michel Sauret
entries.note: Three French soldiers (92e RI, Sept. 2023) standing, front, knees up: CCE uniforms; F3-type helmets, one bare coyote with NVG shroud and rails, two covered or scrimmed; coyote modular plate carriers with magazine and utility pouches; HK416 F rifles with training markers.

entries.author: U.S. Army Reserve photo by Michel Sauret
entries.note: French sergeant (92e RI, Sept. 2023) moving, near left profile, upper body only: covered F3 helmet showing its side rail and chinstrap, coyote plate carrier shoulder and side pouches, CCE sleeve with flag and rank patches, HK416 F carried.

entries.author: U.S. Army Reserve photo by Michel Sauret
entries.note: French soldier (92e RI, Sept. 2023) running, from behind and left, full body: back panel of the coyote plate carrier (laser-cut slots), dump pouch and belt, CCE trousers, covered helmet with scrim; VBCI behind.

entries.author: U.S. Army Reserve photo by Michel Sauret
entries.note: French soldier (92e RI, Sept. 2023) portrait, front, waist up: F3 helmet with scrimmed cover and NVG shroud, headset, mesh face scarf, coyote plate carrier front, CCE jacket, HK416 F-C with holographic sight held across the chest.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Christian Aquino
entries.note: Akeron MP (MMP) firing post deployed on its tripod in woodland, front-left, a French gunner (92e RI, Saber Junction 23, Sept. 2023) kneeling at the sight: CCE uniform, covered helmet, coyote carrier; the launcher's sight and firing unit box from the front.
